title: Wine & Cheese Half Day Tour - Niagara On The Lake Wine Tour
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off ( Niagara Falls & Niagara On The Lake)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the wonderful wines of Niagara-on-the-Lake, Ontario, Canada on this 4+ hour tour to 3 separate wineries. Enjoy tastings of three to four  wines at each stop including award wining ice wine, Enjoy a wine and cheese pairing at one winery.  Learn about the winemaking process and the wines themselves, while trying to discover each wine’s unique tasting notes. Its a good idea to bring snacks as lunch is not served on this tour.
